scripts.build: pnpm check:licenses && pnpm --filter app tauri build
scripts.test: pnpm -r test && node --test "scripts/**/*.test.mjs" && cargo test --manifest-path app/src-tauri/Cargo.toml
scripts.lint: eslint . && prettier --check . && cargo fmt --manifest-path app/src-tauri/Cargo.toml --check && cargo clippy --manifest-path app/src-tauri/Cargo.toml --all-targets -- -D warnings
